status: UNRELEASED PROPOSED POWER CIRCUIT - SOURCE REVIEW ONLY
ownership: Power input/protection/buck/indicator LDO and COM bleeder. J4/SW1/header/output/sinks owned by logic_spec; MCU/LEDs/ADC/programming owned by indicator_spec.
topology: EXT_RAW -> F20 -> V_EXT_FUSED; D20 bidirectional TVS from fused node toGND.
Q20 reverse-polarity P-FET: drain=fused input, source=V_EXT_PROT,12V source-to-gate clamp and100k gate pull-down.
V_EXT_PROT -> D22 -> BUCK_VIN -> MP2459/L20 -> V5_REG -> D25 -> V5_SELECT; R28 discharges V5_REG in both selector positions.
SW1 selects V5_SELECT or V_EXT_PROT to COM_PLUS.
COM_PLUS ->82ohm R26 -> BAT46W D26 -> C25/V_IND_IN -> AP7375 -> V_IND_3V3.

voltage_screen.warning: FB bias current has typical value only; regulator temperature, diode cold behavior, cable losses and switching ripple need measured corners. D25 has no minimum forward-voltage guarantee, so do not claim COM<=5.0V across all corners. These are arithmetic screens, not guaranteed total output bounds.

reverse_collapse_basis.strategy: Series diode isolates indicator input reservoir; input capacitance near critical3.3V exceeds worst nominal/tolerance/temperature output capacitance plus100n MCUdecap. R27 ensures output discharge even while MCU/BOD off.
constraints: No external power into V_IND_3V3/UPDI. Programmer voltage is target-powered reference only.
No added rail bulk capacitance without review.
ADC filter connected to ADC, not directly to VDD; its bounded injection is included by indicator reviewer.
AP7375 VOUT−VIN<=0.3V must be scoped through abrupt COM short, ramp-down, selector dead interval and repeated brownout.
An input capacitor does not qualify arbitrary regulator reverse-current behavior; retain this explicit prototype gate.

buck_collapse_basis.strategy: D22 isolates input capacitor, and330ohm R28 continuously discharges output including when EXT is selected.
buck_collapse_basis.qualification: MP2459 SW absolute maximum is VIN+0.3V. IQ is specified at12V/25C, not across/below UVLO; scope SW,VIN,VOUT on shutdown in both selector modes. Screens are not manufacturer guarantees.

release_gates: Cross-check all part pinouts and footprint lands against current primary drawings.
Capture manufacturer capacitor curves and final pulse-energy/current screening.
ERC/DRC/native netlist parity and one-sided mechanical packing still not performed.
Bench90mA buck startup/regulation/ripple/thermal,0..50C target and12/24V nominal input corners.
Scope buck SW versus VIN through abrupt input collapse and shutdown with EXT selected.
Input reverse polarity, current-limited shorts, TVS/fuse pulse coordination and ringing below absolute ratings.
Indicator input-collapse and ADC prebias behavior; no programmer backfeed.
Exact procurement and complete landed cost inclPCB,harness,labor,yield,shipping/taxes.
